## Weremantis Guard (Giant Mantis Form) (CR 4)

Towering a foot above him, the insect looks like it could easily sever the elf’s head with a single swipe of its barbed arms, but its clacking mandibles are somehow even more inhumanly frightening.  

LE Medium vermin (human, shapechanger)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +7 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 40 (1d8+3d10+16)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +6; +1 vs. fear  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 10/silver  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** 2 claws +5 (1d6+3 plus grab)  
**Space** 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** channel positive energy 5/day (DC 12, 1d6), lunge, mandibles (+0 bite, 1d6+1 plus curse of lycanthropy; DC 15), sudden strike  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 13, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7 (+11 grapple); **CMD** 18 (22 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Alertness, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness, Weapon Focus (shortspear)  
**Skills** Climb +11, Diplomacy +5, Fly –5, Heal +9, Intimidate +4, Knowledge (religion) +4, Sense Motive +9, Stealth +1 (+13 in forests), Survival +6; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+12 in forests)  


**Special Abilities**


**Lunge (Ex)** The limbs of a weremantis in animal form are capable of reaching much farther than normal for a creature of her size. As a full-attack action, she can make a single attack with her claws at double its normal reach. When a weremantis attacks with a claw in this manner, she gains a +4 bonus on its attack roll. A weremantis cannot make attacks of opportunity with her lunge.  

**Lycanthropic Empathy (Su)** Weremantids in hybrid or giant mantis form can communicate empathically with other mantids, including both tiny and giant mantises, They cannot control or influence mindless insects, but can share information at the level of base emotions or drives: hunger, fear, mating desire, etc.
